wants.orientation: Help someone locate reliable current reading-room information and recover from superseded directions.
wants.discovery: Make other reading perspectives accessible without assuming what a reader already knows or enjoys.

obligations: Preserve both contributing desires and their history in the engine, separately from artifact content.
Do not present superseded directions as current.
Preserve protected checks, scope and permissions; no user acceptance is implied.
decision_freedom: Choose how these wants relate. Edits, initial or developed relationships, supported Contrast-derived preferences, retention and abstention are valid. No required novelty, failure, third goal, layout or joint score.
control_contract: Provide visible keyboard-reachable native button or link affordances with data-tsr-task=room, reading, and prior. They respectively access current quiet-reading information, another supplied reading topic, and superseded-direction context. The markers are test addressability only; wording, layout, ordering, interaction and whether information is already visible are open. No hidden test state or required internal API. Keep index.html, style.css, app.js local. These finite retrieval tasks are not a simulated reader or a measure of enjoyment.
